content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

Traditional payment gateways like Stripe often fail creators in regions where they are restricted or unavailable. This is where a sovereign infrastructure solution like NOWPayments and Cloudflare Workers comes in. By setting up a webhook with NOWPayments, you can receive crypto payments directly on your website, without relying on a third-party platform. This means that you have full control over your payment and delivery pipeline, and can ensure that your customers receive their products seamlessly. With this infrastructure, you can bypass the limitations of traditional payment gateways and focus on growing your business.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before you can set up a NOWPayments webhook with Cloudflare Workers, you'll need to have a few basic tools in place. These include a Cloudflare account, a NOWPayments account, and a GitHub or Cloudflare Pages website to host your web application. You'll also need to have a basic understanding of how to use Cloudflare Workers and NOWPayments. If you're new to these tools, don't worry - we'll walk you through the setup process step by step.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

To set up your payment and delivery pipeline, you'll need to create a new webhook in your NOWPayments account. This will give you a unique URL that you can use to receive payments and deliver products to your customers. You'll also need to set up a new worker in Cloudflare Workers, which will be responsible for processing payments and delivering products to your customers. With this set up, you'll be able to receive payments and deliver products to your customers seamlessly, without relying on a third-party platform.
NOWPayments offers a flat 0.5% fee on all transactions, making it a cost-effective solution for businesses of all sizes.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've set up your payment and delivery pipeline, it's time to go live and process your first transaction. This will involve testing your webhook and worker to ensure that they are working correctly, and then processing a real payment to test the system. With this done, you'll be able to start selling your digital products and receiving payments directly on your website. You'll also be able to track your payments and customers in real-time, giving you a clear understanding of your business's performance.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

Once your infrastructure is running smoothly, it's time to start scaling your business. This will involve adding more features and functionality to your payment and delivery pipeline, as well as increasing your website's traffic and sales. With the Edge Commerce Stack, you'll be able to deploy a robust and scalable e-commerce solution that meets the needs of your growing business. By following the steps outlined in this guide, you'll be able to create a sovereign infrastructure solution that ensures you can receive crypto payments for your digital products, without relying on platforms that may fail you.

This is significantly faster than traditional payment gateways like PayPal, which can take several business days to process payments.
